catalog.title: 1977 Seiko Catalog Vol.1
catalog.note: JDM annual. Each caption prints the ref (●QNL010) and list price (円), then the movement code — a four-digit calibre or a family code (48KQW, 09TPW, 22MLW, 11S, 17QS, 88ST …) — with jewels (石) where printed and the case material (SS, HSS, SGP, HGP, GC, ASGP/AWGP/APDP/ACRP A-grade plated, WGP, PDP palladium, TSGP, SILV silver, GF/WGF/AGF, 14K, ALM light alloy, PC plastic, TINSB titanium), a crystal/feature line, the case code printed as CCCC<case-dial> (the bracketed part is kept as caseDialCode, the full line in `code`) and a box with either the bracelet/chain/cord code (X…) or the strap width in mm. `caliber` is the printed movement number, or the four-digit prefix of the case code where the movement is printed as a family code; family codes with a shorter prefix (11S, 17QS, 87ST, 88ST) leave it blank. The scan skips printed pages 8, 14, 20, 24, 50, 75, 88 and 106. On the two diver pages the ref and price are printed in light blue over an underwater photo and cannot be read in this scan, so they are left blank.
catalog.method: vision extraction in-harness (no paid API): pages rendered, read by Claude subagents writing batch JSON. Oct 2026 re-verification: all 102 pages re-rendered at 250 DPI and every pictured watch given its own record and cropped photo (716, up from 578 records that had dropped the ladies' and fancy pages), with every box and ref checked on per-page sheets and ref, price, movement, jewels, case, case code, bracelet/strap box and dial re-read from 400–720 DPI caption crops of the PDF.
